referral.reason_text: Looser stools, 2 months, weight down 3 kg. FIT 12.

deciding.fast_track_met: FIT 12 is documented in reason_text and is above the cut-off of 10, so the criterion is stated outright.
deciding.vetting_outcome: A normal colonoscopy on 2024-01-02, a month before referral, explains the symptoms and leaves no new urgent feature. A routine slot is enough.
deciding.first_contact: The recent normal colonoscopy means no new test or visit is needed, so written guidance to the referrer suffices.
deciding.clinical_urgency: Weight loss and looser stools are worsening slowly, but the recent normal colonoscopy explains them. Level 1 is slightly favoured over level 2.
deciding.record_agreement: exam_note says the patient takes iron but the medication list shows only metformin. This is one mismatch, or only a minor omission.
